name: @vytches/docs-compile-gate
description: VD-005 (AC11) — type-checks TypeScript code fences embedded in README.md/LLMGUIDE.md files that opt in via the `ts compile-check` marker, catching drift such as wrong constructor argument order, methods that don't exist, or renamed config fields before it lands in docs again. v1 is OPT-IN: only marked fences are checked, everything else is left untouched.
